value.credibility_line: Management underpromised on revenue, over-pessimistic on margins, but kept capex flowing.

promises.delivered: FY26 revenue rose 5.8% YoY to INR1145 cr (vs INR1082 cr FY25).

promises.promise: PAT margin will be 27.9% in FY26.
promises.delivered: PAT margin FY26 was 39.7% (PAT INR455 cr / revenue INR1145 cr).

promises.promise: Continue investing in technology and people over the next few years.
promises.delivered: Investing cash flow was -₹185 cr in FY26 and fixed assets grew to ₹507 cr, showing ongoing capex.

promises.promise: Assume a 20% rate impact on revenues if volumes remain constant.
promises.delivered: Volume data not disclosed; revenue impact cannot be quantified.

promises.promise: Folio additions expected from IPO activity in the first quarter.
promises.delivered: Folio count not disclosed; cannot verify additions.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management said FY26 revenue would decline 22% YoY.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Revenue grew 5.8% YoY to INR1145 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management said profit margin would be 27.9% PAT in FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Actual PAT margin was 39.7% (PAT INR455 cr / revenue INR1145 cr).

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management indicated continued technology and employee investment.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Investing cash flow remained negative and fixed assets rose, confirming ongoing capex.

guidance_now: No explicit guidance disclosed in the Nov 2026 call.
bull: Revenue grew 5.8% YoY in FY26 despite guidance of decline.
EBITDA margin peaked at 57.9% in Sep 2026 quarter.
Investing cash flow remained negative, confirming continued capex.
bear: Management missed its FY26 revenue guidance of a 22% decline.
Profit margin guidance was overly pessimistic, actual margin was higher.
Capex spending slowed, investing cash flow fell 38% YoY to -₹185 cr.
questions: What is the target capex spend for FY27 and its allocation across technology versus people?
Can you quantify expected folio addition volume for FY27, especially given IPO-driven reset?
What is the assumed fee rate impact and mitigation plan for a potential 20% reduction?
